modules.title: 世界观常识
modules.intro: 概念学的基础知识：概念、行者、印记、念与阶级。

pages.title: 概念学
pages.subtitle: Conceptology
pages.summary: **概念学**是《理想乡》的世界观基础。世界上常见的抽象概念——愤怒、自由、命运——都是拥有意志的存在，被称为**概念**。与概念交易、获得力量的人类被称为[[行者]]。

sections.title: 概念
sections.body:
概念是世界扭曲的本质。你可以把它们当做小时候看的童话书中的小精灵：有的比较友善，有的对人类抱有很大的敌意。

> 概念有，也必须有两面性，这是不变的法则。

例如【极端冷静】和【极端愤怒】都属于[[极端]]。
sections.body_en:
Concepts are the warped essence of the world. Think of them as the little sprites from childhood fairy tales: some are friendly, some deeply hostile to humans.

> A concept has — and must have — two sides. That is an unchanging law.

For example, 【Extreme Calm】 and 【Extreme Rage】 both belong to [[Extremity]].

sections.title: 行者与共鸣印记
sections.body:
概念与行者之间是**交易关系**：概念给予力量和奖励，行者付出代价。

每位行者身上都有一种印记，既代表他们是被概念选中的人，也代表有概念与他们做了交易。这种印记被称为**【共鸣印记】**。

- 印记无法去除或隐藏，但可以被衣服遮住
- 越强的行者，印记覆盖的范围越大
- 印记的作用是让人承受力量，就像撑住高楼大厦的地基
sections.body_en:
Concepts and Walkers have a **transactional relationship**: the concept grants power and rewards, and the Walker pays a price.

Every Walker bears a mark that shows they were chosen by a concept and that a deal was made. It is called a **【Resonance Mark】**.

- A Mark cannot be removed or hidden, though clothing can cover it
- The stronger the Walker, the larger the Mark
- The Mark lets a body bear the power, like the foundation under a skyscraper

sections.title: 概念化与傀儡
sections.body: 如果力量变强但印记没有变大，行者就会陷入危险，很有可能**概念化**。概念化是不可逆转的，他们都会变成概念的**傀儡**。
sections.body_en: If the power grows but the Mark does not, the Walker is in danger of **conceptualization**. It is irreversible: they all become the concept’s **puppets**.

sections.title: 念
sections.body: 说好听点叫念力，说不好听点就是**注意力**。行者靠念捕捉震动、气味、温度、呼吸声等一切信息。
sections.body_en: Put nicely, it is psychic power; put bluntly, it is **attention**. Walkers use Nen to pick up vibrations, smells, temperature, breathing — every scrap of information.

sections.title: 阶级
sections.body:
行者的等级按概念对身体所修改的程度，也就是**身体基础强度**来划分，而不是能力本身的强度。

- **三阶**：可以做到导弹级别的攻击，接近音速甚至超音速移动
- **四阶**：[[序列]]所在的阶级
sections.body_en:
A Walker’s Tier is set by how much the concept has altered their body — their **base physical strength** — not by how strong the ability itself is.

- **Tier Three**: missile-level attacks; near-sonic or supersonic movement
- **Tier Four**: the Tier of the [[Sequence|Sequences]]

pages.summary_en: **Conceptology** is the foundation of ARCADIA’s world. Everyday abstract ideas — anger, freedom, fate — are beings with wills of their own, called **Concepts**. Humans who strike deals with them and gain power are called [[Walker|Walkers]].

pages.title: 三大纪元
pages.summary: 根据史书《造物纪全篇》《救世纪全篇》和《共鸣纪●始》，世界历史分为三个纪元。时间线见[事件模块](#/m/events)。

sections.title: 造物纪
sections.body: [[造物主]]创造了万物，并发现了概念，对概念进行了深度的实验。随后灾难降临，概念开始入侵现实，造物主因此陨落。
sections.body_en: [[The Creator]] made all things and discovered the concepts, experimenting on them deeply. Then disaster struck: concepts began invading reality, and the Creator fell.

sections.title: 救世纪
sections.body: 一位名为[[救世主]]的人与概念抗衡，最终以陷入疯狂为代价，换回了世界的一丝生存的可能性。
sections.body_en: A man called [[The Savior]] stood against the concepts. In the end, at the cost of his sanity, he won back a sliver of hope for the world.

sections.title: 共鸣纪
sections.body: 辉煌的共鸣纪，也就是现在。[[共鸣主]]与概念立下契约，共鸣印记便这样诞生了。
sections.body_en: The glorious Era of Resonance — the present. [[The Resonator]] made a pact with the concepts, and Resonance Marks were born.

pages.summary_en: According to the Chronicles — *The Era of Creation: Complete*, *The Era of Salvation: Complete* and *The Era of Resonance●Genesis* — history is divided into three eras. See the [timeline](#/m/events).

entries.title: 星晨
entries.summary: 第一篇的主角之一，高一学生，三阶[[极端]]行者，同时是正规特种兵。

infobox.v: 官方正规军（一个圆加三条杠）
infobox.v_en: Authority regular army (a circle and three bars)

sections.title: 身世
sections.body: 母亲是纯种极端傀儡，在极端化的情况下生下了他，没过多久便失去了生命。他因为概念的力量被关在观察室里，直到序列二【自由】亲手把他带了出来。
sections.body_en: His mother was a pure-strain Extremity puppet who gave birth to him while conceptualized, and died soon after. Because of the concept’s power he was locked in an observation room, until Sequence Two, 【Freedom】, personally led him out.

sections.title: 性格
sections.body: 表面平静，喜欢喝绿茶。嘴上爱斗嘴，对学姐的“顶级智斗”毫无察觉。
sections.body_en: Calm on the surface, fond of green tea. Loves to bicker, and is completely oblivious to Senpai’s “galaxy-brain schemes”.

entries.summary_en: A protagonist of Part One: a first-year high schooler, a Tier Three [[Extremity]] Walker, and a regular special-forces soldier.

entries.title: 忻苑
entries.summary: 高二学生，银发，第一章的叙述者。总想着蹭学弟的饭。
entries.summary_en: A second-year with silver hair and the narrator of Chapter 1. Always scheming to get a free meal out of her kouhai.

entries.title: 希罗
entries.summary_en: The school belle of the second year, a Judgement Walker.

entries.title: 极端
entries.summary: [[星晨]]所签约的概念，在他的脑海里说话，被他叫作“老登”。

sections.title: 能力
sections.body:
极端的能力很简单：极端化，和不断的极端化。

两个极端行者打起来就是一场灾难——你打我，我变强；我打你，你变强。
sections.body_en:
Extremity’s power is simple: extremize, and keep extremizing.

When two Extremity Walkers fight it’s a disaster — you hit me, I get stronger; I hit you, you get stronger.

entries.summary_en: The concept [[Starmorni]] made a deal with. It talks inside his head, and he calls it “Old Geezer”.

entries.title: 混乱
entries.summary: 六面体之一，与永恒对立。说话的语序是乱的。
entries.summary_en: One of the Hexahedra, opposed to Eternity. Its word order is scrambled.

entries.title: 共鸣主
entries.summary: 共鸣纪的主，与概念立下契约，共鸣印记由此诞生。
entries.summary_en: Lord of the Era of Resonance. His pact with the concepts gave birth to Resonance Marks.

entries.title: 造物主
entries.summary: 造物纪的开创者，象征【全知】。
entries.summary_en: Founder of the Era of Creation, symbol of 【Omniscience】.

entries.title: 救世主
entries.summary_en: Lord of the Era of Salvation, symbol of 【Omnipotence】.
